Dental crowns are a reliable and natural-looking solution to restore and protect damaged, weakened, or decayed teeth. At Nash Dental Group, we use high-quality, durable materials and advanced dental technology to create crowns that look, feel, and function just like your natural teeth. Whether you need to strengthen a tooth after a root canal, restore a cracked tooth, or improve the appearance of a misshapen tooth, crowns offer long-lasting support and aesthetic enhancement.

Each crown is custom-designed to match the shape, color, and bite of your existing teeth, ensuring a comfortable and seamless fit. Crowns not only restore strength and functionality but also protect your tooth structure and help prevent further damage.

Our experienced dental team provides a smooth and stress-free crown placement process. From your initial consultation and digital impressions to final fitting, we focus on delivering results that are beautiful, functional, and built to last.

A dental crown is a custom-made cap placed over a damaged or weakened tooth to restore its strength, shape, and natural appearance.

[/et_pb_blurb][et_pb_blurb title=”When might I need a crown?” _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” header_font=”Noto Serif Display|700|||||||” header_font_size=”30px” body_font=”Nunito||||||||” body_font_size=”18px” body_line_height=”1.4em” header_text_align_tablet=”” header_text_align_phone=”center” header_text_align_last_edited=”on|phone” body_text_align_tablet=”” body_text_align_phone=”center” body_text_align_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Crowns are often recommended for teeth that are cracked, worn down, severely decayed, discolored, or treated with a root canal. They can also be used to support a dental bridge or cover an implant.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.22.1″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_blurb title=”How long do dental crowns last?” _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” header_font=”Noto Serif Display|700|||||||” header_font_size=”30px” body_font=”Nunito||||||||” body_font_size=”18px” body_line_height=”1.4em” header_text_align_tablet=”” header_text_align_phone=”center” header_text_align_last_edited=”on|phone” body_text_align_tablet=”” body_text_align_phone=”center” body_text_align_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

With proper care, crowns can last 10–15 years or longer. Good oral hygiene and regular dental checkups are essential to maintaining their longevity.

[/et_pb_blurb][et_pb_blurb title=”How do I care for my crown?” _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” header_font=”Noto Serif Display|700|||||||” header_font_size=”28px” body_font=”Nunito||||||||” body_font_size=”18px” body_line_height=”1.4em” header_text_align_tablet=”” header_text_align_phone=”center” header_text_align_last_edited=”on|phone” body_text_align_tablet=”” body_text_align_phone=”center” body_text_align_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Brush and floss daily, avoid chewing on hard objects, and schedule regular dental visits to keep your crown and surrounding teeth healthy.
